fields.summary_ko.0: Reddit (RDDT) Q2 advertising revenue reached $762M, a 64% year-over-year increase, exceeding total revenue growth of 61%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Reddit Max, an AI-powered ad automation product, saw usage increase over 60% quarter-over-quarter, with Max campaign revenue increasing over 150%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Meta Platforms (META) reported Q3 advertising revenue of $63.1B, a 26% year-over-year increase, with strong demand across Facebook, Instagram, and Threads.
